info.title: InvoiceWise API
info.description: Versioned InvoiceWise API. Authenticate with an API key as a bearer token. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message"}}`. Guide: https://github.com/ziahm6638/invoicewise/blob/main/docs/api.md

parameters.name: idempotency-key

schema.description: Optional client key (1-255 visible ASCII characters). Repeating a request with the same key and bytes returns the same invoice; the same key with different bytes is refused with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

parameters.description: Optional client key (1-255 visible ASCII characters). Repeating a request with the same key and bytes returns the same invoice; the same key with different bytes is refused with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

status.description: `processing` while the document is being read; `processed` once it was read (see `validation` and `delivery` for what followed); `failed` when reading failed (see `processingError`, and re-extract).

deduplicated.description: True when this content (or this idempotency key) was already accepted: the existing invoice is returned and nothing is processed or delivered again.

400.description: The request is invalid: `invalid_request`, `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_idempotency_key`, `malformed` or an intake refusal code.

post.description: Accepts one document as multipart/form-data (`file`) and queues it for processing. Validation, storage and processing are the dashboard's own intake. Poll `GET /v1/invoices/{id}` until `status` is no longer `processing`.

amount.description: The document's gross total as printed, in `currency`.

extraction.description: The canonical extraction record with per-value evidence; see docs/document-intake.md#persisted-result.

validation.description: Deterministic checks and accounting readiness; see docs/document-intake.md#validation.

status.description: `unknown`, `not_applicable` and `failed` are never a No or a zero.

probability.description: Boolean questions: the probability the answer is yes.

reason.description: Why an answer is `unknown` or `not_applicable`, or why evaluation `failed`.

runId.description: The deliberate rerun that recorded the answer; null for processing's answer.

delivery.description: Outcome of the current revision's destinations (webhooks and accounting).

discrepancies.description: Codes of the variances found (for example `over_authorized_total`, `rate_above_authorized`).

unresolved.description: Codes of what could not be compared (for example `currency_mismatch`); never read as a pass.

revision.description: The invoice revision this reconciliation is of.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` with the same filters for the next page; null on the last page.
